name: Shenzhen Vital New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Vital New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electronic materials in China and internationally. The company offers microelectronic soldering materials, including solder paste, solder bars, and solder wire, fluxes, cleaning agents, thinners, and microelectronic auxiliary welding materials. It also provides material solutions for automotive electronics, photovoltaic industry, computer server, industrial equipment, communications equipment, and consumer electronics. The company's products are used in assembly and interconnection of electronic devices in multiple industrial links, such as PCBA process; precision structural parts connection; …
